text: Sarah Johnson joined Orion Technologies in 2021 as a senior software engineer. In 2023, she was promoted to Director of Engineering, where she began leading the company's cloud infrastructure team. Orion Technologies is headquartered in Austin, Texas, and operates additional engineering offices in Seattle and Boston.

Orion Technologies acquired DataSphere Analytics in 2022 to expand its data analytics capabilities. DataSphere was founded by Michael Chen, who remained with the company after the acquisition and became its Chief Data Officer. The company develops analytics software for financial services organizations and has major customers in the United States and Canada.

In 2024, Orion Technologies launched Orion Cloud, a platform designed to help enterprises manage distributed applications and data pipelines. Sarah Johnson oversees the engineering organization responsible for Orion Cloud, while Michael Chen leads the platform's data analytics division. Orion Cloud is primarily developed by teams in Austin and Seattle.

The Accounting team at Orion Technologies manages the company's financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and month-end close processes. Laura Martinez leads the team as Vice President of Finance and oversees a group of accountants, financial analysts, and accounting managers. The team works closely with the Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable departments to ensure that vendor payments, customer invoices, and financial records are processed accurately and on time. Most of the Accounting team is based in Austin, while several employees work from the company's Seattle office.

In 2023, Orion Technologies appointed David Wilson as Director of Accounting to lead the company's financial reporting operations. David works closely with Laura Martinez on quarterly financial statements and coordinates with the Legal and Finance teams on compliance requirements. The Accounting team also supports Orion Cloud by tracking revenue, operating expenses, and infrastructure costs associated with the platform. As Orion Cloud expanded, the team created new financial reporting procedures to separate cloud-related expenses from the company's traditional software business.

In 2024, the Accounting team implemented a new financial management system to automate account reconciliation and improve the month-end close process. The project was sponsored by Laura Martinez and managed by David Wilson, with technical support from Orion Technologies' Enterprise Systems team. The new system reduced manual reconciliation work and gave senior management more timely access to financial reports. The Accounting team plans to extend the system to the Seattle office and integrate it with the company's procurement and payroll platforms.

Orion Technologies serves a diverse portfolio of enterprise clients across the United States and Canada. DataSphere Analytics is one of its strategic clients, relying on Orion Cloud for data processing and analytics infrastructure. The company also provides financial technology solutions to Northstar Financial Group, a major client headquartered in Chicago, and supports Acme Retail Corporation with cloud infrastructure and enterprise systems. Orion Technologies' client success team, led by Jennifer Adams, manages these customer relationships and coordinates with the engineering and accounting teams to ensure that client implementations, billing, and ongoing technical support are handled efficiently
